steps: Picked Water War (India vs Pakistan nuclear rivals) from the globe, chose Pakistan
Read the mission card, took office
Approved the staff picks and executed month 1
Read the debrief and the newspaper
scenarios.notes: Only one of 10 months played: the host machine was at load average ~110, so screenshots timed out and actions took 30-60 s. Part of the slowness may be the environment, but I could not tell. No full-screen stinger was seen for the crisis or the month.

steps: Tapped greyed Nuclear strike and Declare war: nothing happened, no reason
Searched 'declare war on india': got the right order
Enter gave a capital toast; removed staff orders to free capital; declare war then never queued
scenarios.notes: Wild moves exist and the search is good, but I never got a war or a nuke to actually happen, and the refusal was a tiny toast that stayed stuck on screen.

suggestions.what: Make the first month of a war or nuke a full-screen animated stinger with sound before the debrief
Greyed or refused wild orders say why in one funny line, on the button, and offer the fix
A Chaos staff mode that pre-fills nothing and surfaces the wildest legal order
Search understands nuke, coup, invade as synonyms
Share card or clip button right on the debrief page

delight: Globe title with pinned flashpoints and a Today's Crisis tag looks great on stream (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/leo-stream/001-title.png)
Newspaper front page with illustrated scene is postable (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/leo-stream/034-e3.png)
Order search with real verbs is quick (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/leo-stream/017-s5.png)

fun.reason: One safe month played; the premise is great but I never got my chaos.

clarity.reason: Desk layout explained in a banner, but dense.

visual.reason: Title globe and newspaper illustrations look good; debrief and desk are dashboard-like.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Menus and cards over a static map; no sound heard, little motion.

agency.reason: Wild orders refused silently or unreliable; staff defaults pull me to safe play.

realism.reason: Real leaders, real flashpoint, believable headlines.

replay.reason: Eight flashpoints and sides invite another run if chaos works.

recommend.reason: I would not put it on stream yet: no big moment landed in my first 30 minutes and slow screens make dead air.

quit_point: Month 1, All orders: Declare war on India would not queue after I freed the capital, and the stuck toast was the only explanation. Dead air on camera, I would switch games.
verbatim: I came to start a war on stream and got a very polite spreadsheet about it.
